# Pull Request

Thanks for contributing! Please make sure:

- [ ] `pytest` (or `python scripts/run_tests.py`) passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check src tests scripts` is clean
- [ ] New behaviour comes with tests in `tests/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md` + `README.zh-CN.md`) if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
